decisions.decision: Server-owned stable logical slots A1-A5, B1-B5, J1-J5, C1 and H1 through starting player count. Bodies retain places; preserve unchanged occupants and holes, allocate entrants lowest free in ascending player number. A/B/Jail capacity five; Healthy free Captain-only Command one; Hospital starting roster size. No Final Zone on this tuple.

Every unblocked Healthy-to-Injured transition immediately changes logical location to Hospital, including detained players. Detention remains independent. Physical Jail occupants plus detained Hospital patients awaiting return cannot exceed five. Fail impossible restored states.

Each fresh injury creates a server-only numbered episode admitted in round R. R1-R4 due death is after R+1 Rescue and R3 Supply; healing clears episode, later injury creates a fresh one. No-op Rescue, detention and reload do not extend it. Second hit eliminates before Rescue. Due death bypasses protection.

Resolve stored actor order Main then Shot, Rescue, R3 Supply, due episode deaths, final placement, authorized reveals and full-stage victory. Free healed Hospital places first. Healed detainees return to Jail; free healed/Command returners use last actual A/B, fallback other ordinary room, ascending player number. Forced transfers spend no voluntary move.

R4 injuries are due after R5 Rescue. Fresh R5/showdown injury has no aging deadline, extra round or Rescue window. Showdown keeps actual locations/detention; all living may register one existing special shot bypassing room/Command and ordinary injury/detention restrictions. Resolve entire registered batch in stored R5 order including shots from earlier-eliminated shooters. Existing protection and full-batch victory apply.

Public/player seats expose exact slotId and nullable medical admittedRound/rescueDueAfterRound/rescueOpportunity. Server computes rescue opportunity from current episode, round and phase; reconnect does not restart an episode. Do not expose private episode count, attacker, role or source. Legacy tuples omit these fields and retain exact behavior.
Inherit exact 1.6 public Hack and G-09 movement boundaries. Capsule remains scenery. Preserve every historical gameplay tuple, receipts, journals, creation/deal/default/art pins.
